info.title: Acton Localnet Control API
info.description: Local development control endpoints exposed by the Acton localnet server. These routes are intended for local tooling. When localnet is started with --require-auth, pass the printed token as Authorization: Bearer <token> or X-API-Key: <token>.

tags.name: Localnet Control
tags.description:
Acton-only control routes for local state, wallets, address names, compiler ABI metadata, simulated network conditions, and raw local message injection.

These routes are intended for local development tooling and should not be exposed publicly. When localnet is started with --require-auth, these routes require the localnet API token. Rate limiting applies only to /api routes, and response delay applies only to TonCenter-compatible API routes; control routes remain available when --rate-limit or --response-delay-ms is enabled.

post.description: Queues a local faucet transfer to credit an address. The transfer is included on the next automatic or manually mined block.

Finds the jetton master in localnet state, verifies that it is mintable and has an admin, converts the display amount using the decimals from jetton metadata, preflights the legacy 0x15 and current 0x642b7d07 mint layouts, and queues the uniquely accepted message for the next block.

get.description: Returns local names for the requested addresses. Missing names are returned as null.

post.description: Sets or updates the local name for an address.

get.description: Returns extended contract ABI metadata for the requested code hashes. Missing ABI entries are returned as null.
Returns compiler ABI metadata registered directly in the localnet node.

post.description: Deletes a locally registered compiler ABI entry by code hash or one of its code hash aliases.

get.description: Proxies Acton verifier source lookup by address or code hash and returns verified source bundles when the contract is confirmed.
Returns source bundles registered directly in the localnet node by address or code hash.
Returns source bundles registered directly in the localnet node.

post.description: Deletes a locally registered source bundle by code hash.
Registers one or more extended compiler ABI payloads for later explorer and API lookups by code hash.
Registers one or more source artifacts for later explorer source-code and retrace lookups by code hash.

get.description: Returns the current live localnet state as a JSON document.

post.description: Replaces the current node state from the request body and clears all checkpoints.
Creates a named in-memory checkpoint for the current localnet state.

get.description: Lists named in-memory checkpoints in the current localnet process.

post.description: Restores a checkpoint without deleting it or checkpoints created after it.
Replaces the selected account state with a base64-encoded ShardAccount BOC.

Changes the selected local account state to nonexist, uninit, or frozen. When state is frozen with source=current, set mine=false to queue the synthetic freeze transaction for the next mined block instead of committing a block immediately.
Injects a base64-encoded internal message BOC into the local internal queue. TonCenter-compatible message endpoints accept external-in messages only.

get.description: Returns wallets selected when the localnet server started.

post.description: Manually mines queued and/or empty localnet blocks. When the request body is omitted or blocks is not provided, one block is mined.
Adds seconds to the localnet virtual clock. Future blocks use this adjusted time until it is changed again.
Sets the localnet virtual clock to a Unix timestamp. The timestamp must not be lower than the latest mined block time.
Sets a one-shot Unix timestamp for the next mined block. The timestamp is consumed by the next automatic or manually mined block and must not be lower than the latest mined block time.

Updates simulated network conditions while the localnet server is running and returns the updated values. Set response_delay_ms to 0 to disable response delay. Current values are also available from /acton_nodeInfo.

get.description: Returns uptime, latest block seqno, local or remote state-source information, and current simulated network conditions.

BearerAuth.description: Localnet API token printed by `acton localnet start --require-auth`.

APIKeyHeader.name: X-API-Key
APIKeyHeader.description: Alternative localnet API token header for TonCenter-compatible clients.

NullResponse.description: Successful wrapped response with null result.

StringOrNullResponse.description: Successful wrapped response with a string or null result.

AddressNamesResponse.description: Successful wrapped response with address names keyed by requested address.

JsonOrNullResponse.description: Successful wrapped response with JSON metadata or null result.

CompilerAbisResponse.description: Successful wrapped response with extended contract ABI metadata keyed by requested code hash.

RegisteredCompilerAbisResponse.description: Successful wrapped response with registered compiler ABI metadata.

VerifiedSourceResponse.description: Successful wrapped response with source bundles returned by the Acton verifier.

RegisteredVerifiedSourcesResponse.description: Successful wrapped response with registered source bundles.

Address.description: TON address in raw or user-friendly format.

Hash.description: Hash in hex or base64 format.

amount.description: Positive display-unit amount. The server reads decimals from the jetton master metadata and defaults to 9 when the metadata value is missing or invalid.

mine.description: Whether to commit the state change immediately. Defaults to true. false is supported only for frozen source=current and queues the synthetic freeze transaction for the next automatic or manual block.

ChangeAccountStatePayload.description: Target local account state. Frozen accounts can be derived from the current active StateInit hash with source=current, or set from an explicit frozen_hash.

balance.description: Optional nanotons balance for the uninitialized account. Defaults to 0.

source.description: Freeze the current active account by replacing its StateInit with the StateInit representation hash and preserving its balance.

frozen_hash.description: Explicit 32-byte frozen StateInit hash, encoded as hex or base64.

balance.description: Optional nanotons balance for the frozen account. Defaults to 0.

force.description: Overwrite an existing checkpoint with the same name.

block_seqno.description: Latest block seqno captured by the checkpoint.

seconds.description: Seconds to add to the virtual localnet clock.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp to use for the current virtual localnet time.
Unix timestamp to use for the next mined block only.

current_unix_time.description: Current virtual Unix timestamp used by localnet.

time_offset_seconds.description: Signed offset applied to wall-clock time in seconds.

next_block_timestamp.description: Pending one-shot timestamp for the next mined block, if configured.

response_delay_ms.description: Response delay in milliseconds for /api/v2, /api/v3, and /api/emulate/v1 responses. Use 0 to disable.
Response delay in milliseconds for TonCenter-compatible API responses.

current_unix_time.description: Current virtual Unix timestamp used by localnet.

time_offset_seconds.description: Signed offset applied to wall-clock time in seconds.

next_block_timestamp.description: Pending one-shot timestamp for the next mined block, if configured.
